Risankizumab is a new treatment preparation for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). In the context of the Danish IBD quality database (DANIBD), tracking modern biologics and JAK inhibitors is essential for evaluating treatment outcomes and quality indicators, such as fecal calprotectin measurements in patients receiving relevant therapies (Indicator 5) [^src1]. 

To facilitate better tracking and inclusion in national quality reports, new administrative treatment codes were established for several modern therapies. In 2024, specific treatment codes were created in the [[landspatientregisteret|Landspatientregisteret]] (LPR) for risankizumab, alongside other modern drugs such as [[upadacitinib]], [[filgotinib]], [[mirikizumab]], and [[ozanimod]] [^src1]. This administrative update was a significant methodological change documented in the 2024 DANIBD report, as it enables the accurate inclusion of patients treated with risankizumab into the registry's data for Indicator 5 [^src1].
